author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Writing firmware is a lot harder than writing the chip.

I vibe coded Intel 4004 and the busicom calculator, I think I only burnt 2-3x of my 5 hr tokens limits. It works like a charm.

I tried to vibe code the busicom firmware in Rust, I burnt thru my monthly tokens limits and it is still not done.
